conf.description: BlueCat DDI bam-audit / syslog-raw: hand-built pipeline over BAM's syslog-redirected transaction/session/service-event text, per recommendations.direct.cribl -- branches object-change vs session/auth vs service-event semantics and keeps the syslog header time as _time while retaining the transaction body time as a drift check, since Previous State/Updated State never appear in this syslog form.

conf.comment: bluecat / bam-audit / syslog-raw. BAM's own syslog redirection (separate source from the BDDS DNS/DHCP feeds). ASSUMPTION (no literal line sample given in the work order, unlike querylog/dhcpd): the message body is a sequence of 'Label: value' pairs using BAM's transaction-history column labels verbatim, extracted with a fixed-vocabulary repeating regex_extract capture -- verify against a real BAM syslog sample before trusting in production. Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: record dataset, format, and the label:value assumption
split the syslog header (BSD-style) from the BAM message body

repeating 'Label: value' capture over BAM's fixed transaction-history column vocabulary; several labels are multi-word (Object Type, Previous State, client address, ...) so the produced field names contain spaces

add.name: event.severity
add.value: __e['event level']==='Error' ? 3 : (__e['event level']==='Failed' ? 3 : (__e['event level']==='Warning' ? 4 : (__e['event level']==='Invalid' ? 4 : (__e['event level']==='Info' ? 6 : (__e['event level']==='Success' ? 6 : undefined)))))

functions.description: map the multi-word label:value fields (bracket access, since 'Object Type' etc. cannot go through rename) to BlueCat customs and ECS, and derive severity/outcome/category from event level and Operation
batch-rename the clean (single-word) mapped fields to their ECS targets
use the syslog header time as _time (deliberate choice over the transaction body Time, which is kept as bluecat.bam.transaction.time_raw for a drift check)
